title_cn: 众议员波坎谈温和的克劳利让弗朗西斯卡·洪感到不安
summary: Representative Mark Pocan (D-WI) discusses the closely contested Democratic gubernatorial primary, where David Crowley narrowly edged out Francesca Hong by a margin of just a few thousand votes. Pocan addresses the implications of this tight race for the upcoming general election against Republican Tom Tiffany, emphasizing the challenges the Democratic Party may face in uniting its base around Crowley. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)
